name: Neuro Square Chord Stabs
desc: The same descending minor7 progression driven as hard resonant square stabs with a sidechain-feel pump — a colder, techier flavor of the parallel-chord bed.

code.full: chord("<Am7 Gm7 Fm7 Em7>").dict("ireal").voicing().add(note(${root})).struct("[x ~ x ~] [x ~ ~ x]").s("square").add(note("0,0.06")).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.4, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).lpq(sine.range(4,10).slow(16)).attack(.004).decay(.18).sustain(.1).release(.12).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(12)).room(.4).roomsize(4).delay(.2).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).every(4, x => x.fast(2)).orbit(4).play()
